title: Two Sum
statement:
Given an array of integers and a target value T, find the indices of the two numbers that add up to T.

Return the two indices as a space-separated pair in ascending order. Each input has exactly one solution. You may not use the same element twice.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N and T.
The second line contains N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Two space-separated integers: the indices (0-based, ascending order) of the two numbers.
